statement.excerpt: Companies will poke for loopholes and surely find them.
statement.document_title: First take on the White House Executive Order on AI

our_interpretation: The companies are AI companies subject or potentially subject to EO 14110.
A loophole is an exploitable gap allowing avoidance of an intended obligation under the order.
The prediction requires documented company conduct seeking and identifying such a gap. Actual exploitation would be stronger evidence but is not essential to the words used.
An analyst identifying a possible weakness, or a company seeking a policy change, does not by itself establish the predicted conduct.
criteria.support_condition: Public records document AI companies seeking and identifying usable gaps in EO 14110 obligations while the order applied.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A sufficiently comprehensive record of the order's operation establishes that companies did not seek and identify such gaps. Failure to locate public examples alone is insufficient.
